the frozen raw records and their v1 run statuses (A3 acts at ingestion and classification only, as an overlay with its own label)

scope.XE: covered now (the family with a classification role that runs first)
scope.AIR: covered by reference when the AIR family of addendum A1 runs on the v1 numerics: the same rule is applied to the AIR rows with family = AIR in the seed texts (geometry, B_peak, V_d, mdot, shape and transport as below; the composition corner = A1 corner order [pick(SEED|AIR|geometry|B_peak|V_d|mdot|composition, 4)]), with the same refinements, criteria, outcome and consequence, and the check runs before AIR grid cases beyond smoke, unless A1 or a later addendum registers its own numerics check

solver_timestepping_basis.finding: bridge_lib.jl run_case builds SimParams(grid = EvenGrid(cells), dt, duration, verbose = false); in the pinned HallThruster.jl v0.23.1 the remaining SimParams keyword defaults are adaptive = true, CFL = 0.799, min_dt = 1e-10 s, max_dt = 1e-7 s, num_save = 1000 (printed in this lane from the installed package whose tree hash 7505b3a2a6cfeb6854801de53c6985443aeb8363 equals the Manifest git-tree-sha1 and the tree of commit bfb3019f)
solver_timestepping_basis.consequence: under adaptive stepping SimParams.dt is only the uniform step of the solver's escape hatch (convergence draft solver_timestep_finding, inferred from the source), so a dt-only refinement can be a no-op; the effective step is CFL-limited and shrinks with the cell size. A3 therefore refines time resolution through the grid refinement R1 (label TIMESTEP_REFINED_THROUGH_CFL_IN_R1) and does not run a dt-only refinement. CFL and num_save are not passed by the pinned bridge and are not changed (no bridge change).

selection_rule: geometry: the two v1 geometry points with the smallest and the largest v1 cell count (domain length): G-AMINDHMAX-LH8603 (266 cells) and G-AMAXDHMIN-LH12 (546 cells); centre geometry: the median cell count of the seven points, G-RP1 (339 cells)
corners (16): each of the two extreme geometries x B_peak {BP-LO, BP-HI} x V_d {VD-180, VD-350} x mdot {MF-LO, MF-HI}, in that nested order
centre (1): G-RP1, VD-265, MF-MID, B_peak picked by the seed (v1 has only the two band ends)

per selection, the B(z) shape and the transport candidate are picked by the seed: pick(text, n) = (first 8 bytes of sha256(UTF-8 text) as a big-endian unsigned 64-bit integer) mod n; centre B_peak = [BP-LO, BP-HI][pick(SEED|family|geometry|V_d|mdot|B_peak, 2)]; shape = [BZ-P5B16, BZ-P5B30][pick(SEED|family|geometry|B_peak|V_d|mdot|bz_shape, 2)]; transport = [sgb-screen-01..09][pick(SEED|family|geometry|B_peak|V_d|mdot|transport, 9)] (| is the literal separator, ids as in v1)
check_set.xe_keys_note: computed from the rule above before registration; the Rust generator recomputes them and refuses to write the A3 case file unless they are equal
check_set.smoke_reuse: none: no smoke result is used in the check (no smoke case is in the check set)

refinements.design: one factor at a time, each compared with the same baseline R0 (convergence draft refinement_design)
refinements.R0_baseline: the v1 case object unchanged (v1 numerics: cells = ceil(domain_m / 5e-4), dt 5e-9 s, duration 2e-3 x max(1, domain_m / 0.1) s, average from duration / 2)
refinements.R1_grid: cells = 2 x v1 cells (0.25 mm cells); dt, duration_s, average_start_s and everything physical unchanged; under adaptive stepping this also refines the CFL-limited time step
refinements.R3_duration: duration_s = 2 x v1 duration_s, average_start_s = v1 duration_s (the same 50 % transient discard; averaging window doubled); cells, dt and everything physical unchanged; num_save stays the solver default 1000 (not passed by the bridge), so the saved-frame spacing doubles (recorded)
refinements.not_run: dt-only refinement (solver_timestepping_basis); CFL refinement (needs a bridge change); combined refinement
refinements.runs: 17 cases x 3 = 51 runs per covered family, through bridge_lib.jl run_case in vacuum mode, threads / BLAS pinned to 1, every run recording the v1 per-record provenance plus the A3 refinement id and the v1 key and case_sha256 it derives from

per_case_and_refinement.C-STATUS: the v1 run status (run_status_rule: NUMERICAL_FAILURE > OUT_OF_DOMAIN > NOT_SUSTAINED > PASS) of the refined run equals that of R0; a refined run that is missing counts as NUMERICAL_FAILURE
per_case_and_refinement.C-QUIET: when both runs are numerically valid (status not NUMERICAL_FAILURE), the quiet class Id_rms_rel < 0.5 is identical
per_case_and_refinement.C-ID: when R0 is PASS: |discharge_current_A(Rk) - discharge_current_A(R0)| / |discharge_current_A(R0)| <= 0.02; discharge_power_W = I_d x V_d at fixed V_d inherits C-ID (no separate criterion)
per_case_and_refinement.tolerance_source: convergence draft observables.thrust_N / discharge_current_A proposed_tolerance 0.02 (prior: quiescent Xe runs moved I_d < 0.2 % between 200 / 400 cells and 2 / 4 ms; breathing runs up to 21 %, HISTORY 2026-09-25); fixed here before any refined run

criteria.report_only: relative and absolute deltas of ion_current_A, mass_eff, current_eff, voltage_eff, anode_eff, Te_max_eV, ne_max_m3, Id_rms_rel, Id_pp_rel, Id_f_dominant_Hz (resolution 1 / averaging window), wall_s; no tolerance
criteria.aggregates: delta_T = max over the covered family's check cases with R0 PASS and over R1, R3 of the C-T relative delta; delta_I likewise for C-ID (both reported with their keys)

outcome.A3_ADEQUATE: every check case passes C-STATUS, C-QUIET, C-T and C-ID under R1 and R3
outcome.A3_ADEQUATE_WITH_NUMERICAL_MARGIN: every check case passes C-STATUS and C-QUIET under R1 and R3, and delta_T <= 0.10 and delta_I <= 0.10, but some C-T or C-ID fails
outcome.A3_NOT_ADEQUATE: any C-STATUS or C-QUIET failure, or delta_T > 0.10, or delta_I > 0.10
outcome.A3_NOT_RUN: no committed A3 result for the family: the v1 rules apply unchanged (v1 label NUMERICAL_ADEQUACY_NOT_VERIFIED_FOR_H1, EC-NUM)
outcome.margin_cap_basis: 0.10 bounds the numerical uncertainty that may be carried as a margin instead of withdrawing the family; it is fixed here before any refined run (no in-repo basis beyond the 2 % draft tolerance and the 21 % breathing-run spread)

consequence.A3_ADEQUATE: the scaled v1 numerics stand for the family: points are ingested and classified exactly as v1 says; the record carries the label NUMERICS_A3_ADEQUATE_ON_CHECK_SET with the A3 result sha256; EC-NUM stays listed (sampled check)

A3_ADEQUATE_WITH_NUMERICAL_MARGIN.label: every ingested point of the family carries NUMERICS_A3_MARGIN with delta_T and delta_I
A3_ADEQUATE_WITH_NUMERICAL_MARGIN.point_tests: a v1 Hall point test (T12, T25, XE_FUNC) on a PASS point counts as passing only if it also passes with thrust_N x (1 - delta_T) in place of thrust_N and discharge_power_W x (1 + delta_I) in place of discharge_power_W inside P_bus_fav; a PASS point that passes nominally but not at the margin is NUMERICS_NOT_CONVERGED for that test
A3_ADEQUATE_WITH_NUMERICAL_MARGIN.constraint_status: CLOSES_IN_ENVELOPE iff some point passes at the margin; NON_CLOSING_IN_ENVELOPE iff no point passes nominally and every point is evaluated physics (v1); otherwise NOT_DETERMINABLE_IN_ENVELOPE with blocker NUMERICS_NOT_CONVERGED (count) next to the v1 unknown counts
A3_ADEQUATE_WITH_NUMERICAL_MARGIN.evaluated_physics: NOT_SUSTAINED points stay evaluated physics (no status flip was observed)

A3_NOT_ADEQUATE.label: every PASS and NOT_SUSTAINED point of the family is NUMERICS_NOT_CONVERGED (its raw values are reported with that label)
A3_NOT_ADEQUATE.classification: a NUMERICS_NOT_CONVERGED point is an unknown, like NUMERICAL_FAILURE: it never counts toward feasibility (never CLOSES) and never toward an evaluated non-closure; every Hall test of the family is NOT_DETERMINABLE_IN_ENVELOPE with blocker NUMERICS_NOT_CONVERGED, A9.31 sec. 21 category MISSING_EVIDENCE

consequence.fail_closed_consumer_rule: a consumer (ingestion or the closure harness) that does not implement this overlay must not report CLOSES_IN_ENVELOPE or NON_CLOSING_IN_ENVELOPE for a family whose committed A3 outcome is not A3_ADEQUATE; it reports NOT_DETERMINABLE_IN_ENVELOPE with blocker A3_OVERLAY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED
consequence.never: an A3 outcome never makes a point feasible that v1 does not, never changes a frozen record, and never justifies changing the v1 grid numerics

execution.case_file: cases/h1_parametric_envelope_a3_numerics_cases_v1.json, generated after this lock by the Rust tool (abep-julia-bridge) from the frozen v1 case file: one object per (check case, refinement) = the v1 case object with only the refined numerical fields changed, plus a3_refinement, v1_key and v1_case_sha256; case_sha256 by the v1 convention; byte-reproducible (generate / check)
execution.driver: driver/h1_envelope_a3_driver.jl: verifies check_pin(), this addendum's lock, the v1 lock and pinned inputs, and the A3 case file sha256 against its launch manifest; calls run_case(c, "vacuum") and records the v1 raw-record fields; no status, threshold or verdict
execution.launch: Rust launch (pin, input sha256, julia --version == Manifest julia_version, nine-field sidecar per shard), 3 shards (case index mod 3)
execution.freeze_and_score: the shard outputs are frozen (sha-pinned gzip JSONL + manifest) before scoring; the Rust scorer applies the v1 run-status rule (abep_hall::envelope::run_status) and the criteria above once and writes a3_numerics_result_v1.json / .md, committed whatever the outcome
execution.determinism_diagnostic: report only: the R0 records are compared with the frozen grid records of the same keys once the family's grid is frozen (thrust_N, discharge_current_A, retcode); a difference is reported, never used to change either record
